title: Checks for calls to .or(foo(..)), .unwrap_or(foo(..)), .or_insert(foo(..)) etc., and suggests to use .or_else(|| foo(..)), .unwrap_or_else(|| foo(..)), .unwrap_or_default() or .or_default() etc. instead.
summary: The function will always be called. This is only bad if it allocates or does some non-trivial amount of work. Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for .or(…).unwrap() calls to Options and Results.
summary: You should use .unwrap_or(…) instead for clarity. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.
